  decision = {A \texttt{workflow\_\allowbreak{}dispatch} workflow, refused outside \texttt{main}, runs \texttt{dvc repro} on a GitHub-hosted runner, logs to the DagsHub MLflow, pushes to the DVC remote and opens a draft promotion pull request with the model version, metrics and gate verdict.
A person marks it ready, which starts CI, and merges it.
Its energy figures are kept and labelled as runner estimates.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item CI only reports a stale \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock} and training stays on laptops: the pipeline would never run anywhere but a laptop.
\item Correcting CodeCarbon's CPU power for the runner: more work, with unclear accuracy.
\item CodeCarbon off in CI: models trained there would have no energy figures.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} A forced run of every stage took 333 s and 388 s, at most 3.3 GB of the runner's 16 GB of RAM and 2.4 GB of disk, and cost no Actions minutes on this public repository. It reproduced every committed metric except per-segment shares of the Ridge baseline, which differ between the two CPUs.},
